identity.pseudo_negative_policy: Other functions in the same admitted split and repository are unjudged contrastive candidates. They may be semantically relevant; no independent negative label is asserted.

metric_limitation: Rank and recall cover labeled within-issue candidates only; no full-corpus or repair claim.

protocol.negative_policy: Eight highest frozen-base cosine training candidates; unjudged pseudo-negatives
protocol.pair_weighting: each issue family or source-function target has equal total pair weight
protocol.schedule: cosine over fixed global steps, with learning_rate_floor
protocol.selection: development MRR, then Recall@5, earliest step on ties
